newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh tea prices rise on higher demand.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh tea prices rise on higher demand.

text.p: Prices rose on demand for good liquoring brokens and fannings from local and overseas buyers at the weekly auction on Tuesday, brokers said.
Buyers for Pakistan, Russia, Poland and Afghanistan operated actively, pushing prices of most grades, especially the good liquoring brokens and fannings teas.
More than 973,334 kg of teas were sold at the auction. The average price was 45.02 taka, up 0.69 from the previous sale. The next auction will be held on November 19 with an offer of 1.36 million kg.
